name: Depression
overview: Depression (major depressive disorder) is a mood disorder with persistent low mood, loss of interest, and functional impairment. It is common and treatable with psychotherapy, medicines, and social support.
symptoms: Fatigue, poor concentration, feelings of guilt
Thoughts of self-harm in severe cases
causes: Not a personal weakness — a medical condition
diagnosis: Rule out thyroid disease, anaemia, medication effects
treatment: Crisis support and hospital care if suicidal
prevention: Routine mental health screening in primary care
complications: Poor adherence to chronic disease care
emergencySigns: Inability to care for self or others

faq.question: Can I rely on this Depression information instead of a doctor visit?
faq.answer: No. This content supports learning and preparation for conversations with qualified healthcare professionals. It is not a substitute for diagnosis or treatment.

faq.question: What should I do if Depression symptoms worsen suddenly?
faq.answer: Seek urgent medical care, especially if severe pain, breathing difficulty, confusion, or high fever develops.
